name: flow/screen-flow-carousel
title: Screen flow carousel
title_vi: Băng chuyền màn hình ứng dụng
desc_vi: Hai đến năm màn hình xếp hàng ngang, màn giữa to và sáng; mỗi nhịp cả hàng được ném sang màn kế tiếp rồi dừng êm, vòng nhấn và chú thích bên dưới đổi theo.
params_vi: screens: số màn (2 - 5) · captions: chú thích từng màn (mảng hoặc chuỗi cách nhau dấu phẩy) · cues: giây của từng lần chuyển (rỗng = chia đều) · images: ảnh từng màn (rỗng = màn khung xương) · accent: màu nhấn · exit: none | fade | up · duration: độ dài gốc 5 s · bg, base, fg, surface, border, muted, shadow: màu · radius: bo góc (px, 0 = mặc định)
notes: Geometry, envelope and eases as in the source (screen 44 cqw wide with a 4 cqw gap, rail 64 cqh tall at 9 cqh, captions band at 78 cqh; stage settle 0.9 s; advance 0.84 s = throw 42 % power4.out to pos - 0.14 then catch power2.out; non-active screens scale 0.94 / opacity 0.62; ring and caption swaps with their delays; evenly re-spaced cues clamped inside the hold; exit fade / up 0.45 s; everything shrinks together when the duration is short). cqw / cqh / cqmin are taken from the target box (custom properties --cw / --ch / --cm hold one percent of it; the source demo mounted it in an 84 % x 78 % card, the gallery demo fills the whole frame). The rail position was the CSS custom property --sfc-pos tweened as a number; it is the rail's x here (x = (50 - 22 - pos x 48) cqw in px) with the same two segments, so it is ordinary tweens; the screens, rings and captions are written as fromTo with explicit start values instead of a set + to. Source variables: screens, captions (comma string; array accepted), cues (comma string; array accepted), exit kept; accent is a hex colour (source: green / blue / violet reading theme tokens); theme tokens became params with the source fallbacks (fg #f8fafc, surface #0f141b, border #475569, muted #8b93a3; --bg for painting is `bg`, the dark tone used when mixing is `base` #05070c). Screens are the source's four token-styled skeletons (list, cards, chart, detail) unless `images` gives a picture for that screen (source: slot templates); the first-of-type accent dot rule of the source never matched anything, so the list dots are not tinted, as in the source render. The caption dot (::before in the source) is a real child span. Captions use the system monospace stack (Consolas / Cascadia Mono / Menlo), no font file ships. color-mix() is written as rgba / computed hex. Default captions are Vietnamese (source: Overview, Details, Insights, Activity, Settings). 05/10/2026: monospace text uses the kit's Roboto Mono ("RMono", Vietnamese complete, the same on every machine) before the system stack.
